stances_toward.note: Israel appears and pleads while contesting jurisdiction: its counter-memorial in South Africa's genocide case was filed in March 2026 (after an extension) and objects to jurisdiction; the Court on 21 May 2026 set South Africa's reply for 22 Nov 2027 and Israel's rejoinder for 22 May 2029, so the case runs past any government now in office; the 2024 provisional orders remain. Cooperation out of necessity, resistance on substance: our reading (confidence C). Bond - grievance.
